name: Mobile app flow
description: Eight phone screens for an ordering app (welcome, home, detail, cart, checkout, confirmation, profile and tracking), joined by labelled arrows, with notes on loading, empty and error states.

runs.t: Brewly, a coffee ordering app: eight screens and how people move between them. Rename the screens, then redraw each one with your own content.
